## How to Reproduce This Readout

```bash
# Set env vars (DB + OpenAI)
source .env   # or export manually

# Run preflight
python eval/preflight_check.py --env staging

# Run auto-summary generator
python eval/auto_summary_generator.py --week 22 \
  --output docs/week22_ml_decision_readout.md

# After live ramp completes, update with stage results
python eval/auto_summary_generator.py --week 22 --include-live \
  --output docs/week22_ml_decision_readout.md
```
